dedupe_keys.name: industrial centrifuge condition monitoring data from a sulzer centrifuge at arab potash company jordan 2022 2023

description: This dataset holds one year (September 2022 to August 2023) of multisensor condition monitoring data from an industrial Sulzer centrifuge operating at the Arab Potash Company in Jordan. The Zenodo record says the data were acquired from an ABB 800xA distributed control system at one-minute intervals and include torque (percent of nominal load), vibration velocity (mm/s RMS) and bearing temperatures at the solid and liquid ends, about 525,600 time-aligned observations per variable, with timestamp synchronisation, duplicate removal, interpolation of short gaps and range checks against plant alarm thresholds (vibration 12 mm/s, torque 85 percent, temperature 85 C). It was published in December 2025 by a single author affiliated with Universiti Tenaga Nasional as raw and cleaned CSV and XLSX files (about 161 MB in total) with a readme, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one machine at one potash processing plant. Caveats: the author is named only as "doaa" on the record, and failure events are not labelled on the page read. For simulation it gives real operating and degradation signals for predictive maintenance, remaining useful life and digital twin models of mineral processing equipment. Related catalogue records include the NASA prognostics data repository and the MIMII industrial machine sounds.
